box.highlights: Smithtown West 35, Westhampton 14: Michael Cascione ran for 204 yards and three touchdowns on 14 carries to lead visiting Smithtown West in Suffolk III. Cascione also had seven tackles on defense, two pass break ups and one interception. Jax Cascione added 44 more yards rushing to make 420 yards of total offense. Nick Zins had five tackles, a tackle for loss and quarterback sack. Luke Brown had six tackles, a forced fumble and two pass break ups.

Smithtown West 28, Hauppauge 7: Michael Cascione returned a punt 60 yards for a touchdown and caught a pass for another 28-yard score to help lead Smithtown West (2-0) in Suffolk III. Nick DeVito threw two touchdown passes in the win, the first of which went to Vin Lepore. Thomas Maloney made all four of his extra points and Jake Rearick capped off the win with a rushing touchdown of his own. For Hauppauge (1-1), Giuseppe Calabrese caught a touchdown from Nick LaChapelle.

Smithtown West 13, West Islip 6: Michael Cascione had 143 rushing yards, a touchdown, five tackles and one for a loss to lead host Smithtown West (3-0) in Suffolk III. Vin Lepore had a sack, a forced fumble and a fumble recovery. Nick Zins made nine tackles, with one for a loss. Joe Fitzsimmons added five tackles and pass break up. TJ Sonnenberg connected with Conor Kenefick on a 10-yard score for West Islip (2-1).

East Hampton 45, Smithtown West 7: Jai Feaster had 9 carries for 145 yards and 2 TDs and added 1 sack and 5 tackles to lead host East Hampton / Bridgehampton /Pierson (3-1) in Suffolk III. Alex Davis added 2 rushing TDs and Livs Kuplins had a receiving TD and a rushing TD. Vin Lepore had an 80-yard kickoff return for Smithtown West (3-1).
Patrick Coan completed 11 of 20 passes for 190 yards and a TD and had 21 carries for 106 yards and three TDs for Sayville in Suffolk III.

Smithtown West 41, Rocky Point 14: Nick Zins had 14 tackles and a sack to lead the visiting Smithtown West (4-2) defense in Suffolk III. Brandon Keane had a sack and a tackle for loss with five solo tackles. Jake Rearick had five catches for 193 yards and three touchdowns. Nick DeVito went 9 for 15 with 219 yards and three touchdown passes.  Michael Cascione rushed for 217 yards on 17 carries and two touchdowns

Michael Casscione rushed for 233 yards on 17 carries and scored 4 touchdowns.  He added a 65 yard Punt return for his 5th touchdown of the day.  Nick Devito threw for 168 yards and 2 touchdowns.  Vin Lepore had 3 catches for 87 yards and two touchdowns.  Casscione had 5 tackles defensively and an interception.

Smithtown West 14, Eastport-South Manor 13: Michael Cascione had 23 carries for 188 yards and two touchdowns and blocked Eastport-South Manor's tying PAT kick with 10 minutes left in the fourth quarter to lead host Smithtown West (6-2) in Suffolk III. Cascione added eight tackles. Nick Zins had nine tackles and Joe Fitzsimmons had six tackles, including one for loss and a sack. Max Ferraro ran for 64 yards and two touchdowns for ESM (4-4).

Smithtown West 48, Comsewogue 18: Nick DeVito completed 9 of 15 passes for 253 yards and three touchdowns and added six carries for 110 yards to lead host No. 2 Smithtown West over No. 7 Comsewogue in the Suffolk III quarterfinals. Jake Rearick caught four passes for 133 yards and two TDs and Colton Ford added a 25-yard TD catch. Michael Cascione had 17 carries for 145 yards and three scores. Joey Cantave ran seven times for 96 yards and a TD. Smithtown West (7-2) will host the winner of No. 4 West Islip/No. 5 Hauppauge in the semifinals at 4 p.m. on Friday. 
Nick Saladino and Jack Campagna each ran for a TD for Comsewogue, which finished 5-4.

Smithtown West 42, West Islip 10: Michael Cascione ran 23 times for 251 yards and five touchdowns, leading No. 2 Smithtown West to a home win over No. 3 West Islip in the Suffolk Division III semifinals. Colton Ford had five tackles, two pass break-ups, a forced fumble and an INT. Nick Zins led the team in tackles (10) and added a sack. Zach Engler had three tackles and a sack. Nick DeVito completed 9 of 14 passing attempts for 157 yards. Jake Rearick had four catches for 88 yards. Jovan Brewster ran for a 9-yard TD for West Islip (7-3). Smithtown West (8-2) will face No. 1 Sayville Thursday in the Suffolk Division III championship at Stony Brook University at 4 p.m.

Top-seeded Sayville defeated No. 2 Smithtown West in the Suffolk III final at Stony Brook University. Sayville (11-0) will face the winner of Wantagh/Bethpage in the LIC at 4:30 p.m. on Friday, Nov. 28 at Hofstra.
